author: Crimson_Aught
body:
Right now post "Help with stuff" was archived (maybe) in front of my eyes and just disappeared from forums page with some reason or no reason. I don't know. No one will know.
My suggestion: don't delete rule broken posts and replies totally. Instead of them leave message with reason of removal.

title: [SUG] Disappearing posts

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
I assume the post was archived by the creator (DaFrozenBlaze).
Normally threads only get locked with a message if there is a flamewar, it was bumped or it went offtopic.
If the threads content is against the rules or it breaks any major forums rules it gets archived and since only staff can see the post (not even the creator can), there is no need for a message.

replies.author: Jahaj
replies.body: In my opinion it is not needed. Only if it is advertising or very harmful will a post get archived by a mod, and then it is quite obvious. Most of the time posts just get locked, and if it isn't breaking any rules and disappears, that means the owner archived it.
